name: Grade 9 IT: Robotics Prototype Project
description: Robotics project planning, component lists, subsystems, state charts, test steps, prototypes, reliability, optimization, project logs, evidence, and demonstrations.

words.definition: The field of designing, building, and programming robots or automated systems.
words.example: The robotics project used inputs and outputs.

words.definition: The result a project is trying to achieve.
words.example: The goal was an obstacle alert system.

words.definition: One part used in a system or circuit.
words.example: The component list included LEDs and sensors.

words.definition: A smaller system inside a larger system.
words.example: The light output was one subsystem.

words.definition: A chart that shows system states and what causes changes.
words.example: The state chart described ready, warning, and error.

words.definition: A test version of a design.
words.example: The group built a prototype before the final demonstration.

words.definition: One useful part or behavior of a project.
words.example: The first feature was the warning light.

words.definition: A record of plans, tests, results, and changes.
words.example: The project log included pass/fail results.

words.definition: One planned try to check project behavior.
words.example: The team recorded five test attempts.

words.definition: A test result showing the system met the requirement.
words.example: The alert passed when it turned red at the right time.

words.definition: A test result showing the system did not meet the requirement.
words.example: The output failed when the sensor was covered.

words.definition: How dependably a system works over repeated tests.
words.example: Reliability improved after the wiring was cleaned.

words.definition: Improving a system so it works better or more efficiently.
A note in code that explains what a section does.
words.example: The code comment explained the threshold rule.

words.definition: Information that proves or supports a result.
words.example: Test evidence showed the prototype worked.

words.definition: Showing and explaining how a project works.
words.example: The demonstration explained inputs, outputs, and logic.

words.definition: A review of design success, challenge, and improvement.
words.example: The reflection described one design success.

words.definition: To organize and store project files for later.
words.example: Students archived project files after the trimester.
